description: UC Santa Cruz + China intl with highSchoolLocation set + strong RD (regression: original 4/26 prod returned 19% due to geo+intl double-penalty)
rationale: UCSC now uses official 2024-25 CDS C1 data: overall admit rate 65.57%, international admit rate 77.06%, and geo is skipped for international applicants. Strong GPA/SAT then pushes the counselor output to the anchored cap/absolute ceiling (~98%). The range intentionally allows the high result because real UCSC international data is favorable; it still catches the original bug where intl × OOS double-penalty produced ~19%. This case must use highSchoolLocation: 'CN' to specifically trigger the old bug path.
